description: This file implements a Kubernetes controller for managing certificate signing requests (CSRs). It defines the CertificateController class, its methods for running the controller, handling CSR events, and processing CSR objects.

classes.name: CertificateController
classes.description: A controller that manages Kubernetes CertificateSigningRequests, handling their lifecycle and processing them asynchronously.

methods.name: NewCertificateController
methods.description: Constructor for creating a new CertificateController, setting up event handlers and workqueue.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Starts the controller, manages worker goroutines, and handles shutdown.

methods.name: worker
methods.description: Runs a worker thread that processes CSR items from the queue.

methods.name: processNextWorkItem
methods.description: Processes a single CSR item from the queue, handling retries and error logging.

methods.name: enqueueCertificateRequest
methods.description: Adds a CSR object to the workqueue based on its key.

methods.name: syncFunc
methods.description: Syncs a CSR object by its key, checking its status and invoking the handler if needed.
